Riggy Runkey (officially named Rigmond T. Runkey) is a fictional blue "Runkey", a hybrid creature that is half-rabbit and half-monkey. He is the animated mascot, co-host, and assistant on the popular YouTube channel Danno Cal Drawings, created by animator Danno Cal. The Role:  Riggy acts as a model and actor who stars alongside Danno in educational, fast-fact YouTube Shorts. He also runs his own Riggy The Rabbit Monkey YouTube Channel. Personality:  He is an anarchic, chaotic anti-hero. While usually friendly, he possesses a massive, comedic criminal record featuring arson, tax fraud, and property damage. Relationships:  He has a rabbit girlfriend/fiancée named Rosey and he hates penguins because one allegedly stole his kidney. #fypppppppppppppp #xyzabc #riggytherunkey #dannodraws #toonturf
